connector.name: DB Query Guard MCP
connector.registryDescription: Paid remote MCP for governed database query review, SQL simulation, approvals, and audits.
connector.summary: Hosted at dbqueryguard.clauxel.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.clauxel.dbqueryguard, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.description: Bearer token issued after checkout and MCP token claim.
